title: prompt_continuity_lint — four-rule checker for video-generation prompts
purpose: A small, dependency-free Python linter that checks a structured video-generation prompt against the four continuity interface contracts derived from art_01M68DNWCQ5SYGVT7KQXH69M0Y rev 1: (R1) unique @-tag per character, (R2) binding block before shot labels, (R3) location allow/exclude clauses, (R4) position words present in every detected shot block. Returns a list of (rule, status, detail) tuples. Status is PASS/WARN/FAIL/UNKNOWN. Designed as a pre-submission gate that can be extended or called from a pipeline; not a model or rendering tool.
